reason: I might take the free call and look at the 15 companies, because that costs me nothing. But paying even EUR 500 to an agency from a LinkedIn pitch needs my partner's sign-off, and I would not get that this month on one '45 meetings' story from a logistics client.
objection: I get three or four of these pitches a week. A meeting that 'took place' is not an order. I could pay EUR 3,600 for eight polite calls with buyers who never send a quote, and then I'd have to explain that to my partner.
would_change_my_mind: A reference call with a wholesaler like us who actually got orders, not just meetings, plus a 15-company list good enough that my partner sees names we could never reach through our own network.
